title: Plumbline detector record
description: One record per repository snapshot. schema_version changes whenever the record format or the semantics of any check change; provenance.ruleset_fingerprint identifies the exact check code.

ruleset_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 over the source of every module that defines check semantics.

measurements_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the measurements file the per-check measured_precision values come from.

operator_set.description: Check IDs run, in record order.

config.description: Effective configuration: operator-supplied required checks, gate files (by hash), exclusions, limits.

environment.description: Interpreter and parser versions. The Python grammar accepted depends on the interpreter version.

commit_sha_source.description: operator | git_ref | git_packed_ref | git_head_detached | no_git_metadata | ... (why it is null)

content_id.description: Content address of the snapshot: SHA-256 over sorted (path, file SHA-256) pairs.

label_sha256.description: SHA-256 of an operator-supplied label; the label itself is never recorded.

test_file_count.description: Python files in test paths (see README).

js_test_files.description: JS/TS files following a test naming convention that declare at least one test case.

js_frameworks.description: Test frameworks declared in package.json files.

python_test_data_files.description: Python files classified as test inputs (fixture/resource data), counted but not analyzed.

basis.description: GT checks only: where the required-check set came from.

measured_precision.description: Most recent held-out precision measurement of this check (docs/PRECISION_STUDY.md), or null if it has never produced a finding in a study round. same_ruleset is false when the measurement was made on different check code than the code that produced this record.

id.description: Findings only: stable identifier from check ID, file and message (not line), for diffing records over time.

file.description: Path relative to the snapshot root.
